concept: Global Accelerator: static anycast IPs and fast failover over AWS backbone
tests: Choosing a service to route to the nearest healthy regional endpoint with static IPs.
expected: AWS Global Accelerator — 2 static anycast IPs, traffic over the AWS global network to the nearest healthy endpoint, fast failover, TCP/UDP. Triggers: "static anycast IPs", "AWS global network", "fast failover", "closest healthy endpoint".
why_not: CloudFront — caches HTTP(S) content, not arbitrary TCP/UDP endpoints; Route 53 weighted — by weight, not proximity; ALB — regional.
